filterNotes: Dropped pure-QA/style/centralization noise: all 139 Semgrep hits (use-custom-error-not-require, use-short-revert-string, non-payable-constructor, use-ownable2step, prefix-increment, etc.), Slither missing-zero-check(12), events-access(1), dead-code(1), missing-inheritance(1), too-many-digits, and Aderyn QA items (PUSH0, unspecific-pragma, large-literal, empty-block, modifier-once, unused-import, centralization, ownable2step). Timestamp/deadline detectors KEPT per time-driven-protocol policy.
newContractSummary: NudgeRatchetDelayRelease.sol and base ATokenDispatcherV2.sol produced NO real-vulnerability hit in their function bodies. release() is nonReentrant + SafeERC20.safeTransfer (CEI-clean, return checked). rescueERC20() is onlyOwner + zero-recipient require + safeTransfer. _dispatch() intentionally holds USDC (documented). The only new-contract tool hits are a constructor-CEI false-positive (Aderyn) and modifier-order QA.

findings.description: State assignment (_token = token_) after an external call. The 'external call' is IERC20Metadata(token_).decimals() at line 72-75 inside the constructor; assignment of _token/batchMinter follows.
findings.triage: KNOWN-NOISE / FALSE-POSITIVE — constructor-only, single deploy-time view call to the token's decimals(); no reentrancy surface exists pre-deployment. Standard Aderyn constructor-CEI FP.

findings.description: release(uint256) declares `onlyReleaser nonReentrant`; nonReentrant is not the first modifier.
findings.triage: KNOWN-NOISE — onlyReleaser only reads a mapping (no external call before the guard), so ordering is harmless here. Stylistic QA at most.

findings.description: abi.encodePacked() used with dynamic types before a hash function; can produce hash collisions vs abi.encode().
findings.triage: PRE-EXISTING (not story-043). Carry forward for dedup vs ledger; verify whether the packed args are actually dynamic/adjacent before rating.

findings.description: gemAmt = (usdsAmount * WAD) / (conv * (WAD + tout)) — multiplication on the result of a division can lose precision.
findings.triage: PRE-EXISTING. Likely-true rounding loss but bounded; dedup vs prior runs/ledger.

findings.description: Ignored return values: IERC4626(_sUSDS).deposit (218), ISkyPSM.buyGem (260), IBalancerVault.unlock (274), settle (308), addLiquidity (309). Corroborated by Aderyn 'Unchecked Return' at BalancerPoolerV2:218/260/274/308.
findings.triage: PRE-EXISTING, corroborated by two tools. Mostly intentional (downstream slippage/min-out asserts cover it). Dedup vs ledger.

findings.description: Ignored return values from swapExactTokensForTokens (221) and addLiquidity (234). Corroborated by Aderyn 'Unchecked Return' at Uniboost:221/234.
findings.triage: PRE-EXISTING, two-tool corroborated. minLP/minOut requires cover the swap; likely benign.

findings.description: Uses block.timestamp for comparisons / passes block.timestamp as Uniswap router deadline (offers no MEV protection). Aderyn corroborates ('block.timestamp for swap deadline offers no protection').
